title: dryopteris globulifera
intro: Dryopteris globulifera, commonly known as the globular lady fern, is a type of fern plant that belongs to the Dryopteridaceae family. The health benefits of Dryopteris globulifera include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing the risk of chronic diseases such as cardiovascular disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Dryopteris globulifera include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
